map.输入电池容量、充电电流和充电效率，计算充电时间、电池能量和充电功率: Enter the battery capacity, charging current and charging efficiency to compute the charging time, battery energy and charging power
map.📖 查看「充电时间估算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Charging Time Estimation User Guide"
map.💡 公式：充电时间 = 电池容量 × (1 - 当前电量%) ÷ (充电电流 ×: 💡 Formula: charging time = battery capacity × (1 - current charge %) ÷ (charging current × charging efficiency). Lithium battery charging efficiency is about 80-90%, with a voltage usually of 3.7V.
map.充电效率参考：锂电池约 80~90%，镍氢电池约 65~70%，铅酸电池约 75: Charging efficiency reference: lithium battery about 80-90%, NiMH battery about 65-70%, lead-acid battery about 75-80%
map.快充阶段（0~80%）速度快，涓流阶段（80~100%）速度慢，实际时间会更长: The fast-charge stage (0-80%) is quick while the trickle stage (80-100%) is slow, so the actual time will be longer
map.充电电流不应超过电池容量的 1C（如 3000mAh 电池不超过 3000mA）: The charging current should not exceed 1C of the battery capacity (e.g., no more than 3000mA for a 3000mAh battery)
map.充电宝按电流估算充满时间。: Estimate the full charge time of a power bank by current.
map.电池放电倍率与可用时长。: Battery discharge rate and usable time.
map.10000 mAh（10 Ah）、5 V、输入 2 A：能量 50 Wh，按 2: 10000 mAh (10 Ah), 5 V, input 2 A: energy 50 Wh, charging at 2 A×5 V=10 W gives an ideal 5 h; accounting for 0.9 efficiency and the slower constant-current/constant-voltage tail, the actual time is about 5.5-6 h. Tip: a high current is faster but generates heat, and overcharge protection reduces the current.
map.容量 Ah 直接除电流就是时间吗？: Is the time simply the capacity in Ah divided by the current?
map.对恒流近似成立；但电池有截止电压与效率，且充电末段转恒压电流减小，实际更长。: It holds approximately for constant current; but batteries have a cutoff voltage and efficiency, and the final stage switches to constant voltage with a reduced current, so the actual time is longer.
map.C 率是容量除以电流，1C 即 1 小时放完；倍率越高功率越大但可用容量常略降、: The C rate is capacity divided by current; 1C means fully discharged in 1 hour. The higher the rate, the greater the power, but the usable capacity often drops slightly and heat generation increases.
